versions.content: Simple read calls,as implemented in Adc_ReadGroup and Adc_GetGroupStatus,shall always be reentrant even if the functions are called for same channel groups. It is up to the implementation to use adequate protection mechanisms (e.g. disabling/enabling interrupts.
